name: qemu-alpine-docker
description: Persistent QEMU Alpine Docker VM and status panel for Linux Docker containers and Windows.

interface.shortDescription: QEMU Docker in Linux Docker containers and on Windows.
interface.longDescription: Manages a persistent Alpine Docker VM inside Linux Docker containers or on Windows, with KVM or WHPX acceleration and portable TCG fallback. Runs inside ordinary Linux Docker containers without privileged mode and exposes a read-only VM, service, and container status panel. On Linux hosts outside containers, use Docker directly without this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Set up a QEMU Alpine VM with Docker for development.
Start the Alpine VM and sync project code.
Run host Testcontainers tests against Docker in the Alpine VM.
